nonblocking_maintenance: Update pyproject.toml project.license from the deprecated TOML-table form to an SPDX string before the setuptools 2027-02-18 removal deadline; do this outside the validated submission freeze unless a new G5 artifact is intentionally generated.
science_freeze_policy: Any change to G2 scientific parameters, observation-information semantics, adaptive-recomputation theorem content, frozen numerical claims or distributed package source requires a new protocol/version or intentional G5 artifact freeze. A text-only change to the review manuscript requires a refreshed anonymous reviewer bundle but does not by itself require a new G5 freeze. Metadata-only readiness/title-page updates do not supersede an artifact_validation_sha until the corresponding source-matched workflows succeed.
